page.layout: One page of text in a single column. Running head and page number at the top. Marginal notes in the left margin: "An. Christi" and the year numbers 53 to 59. Line numbers in the right margin (5 to 35). Catchword "Anno" at the lower right.

main_text.p: An. Christiniam veniunt Theffalonicam,Beroeam & Athe-nas.Act.17.poft Corinthum.Act.18.Hoc tempore fcripfit Paulus utramque epiftolam ad Theffalo-nicenses.

53.Paulus Corintho difcedit,poftquam ibi man-5fiffet an. 1.menf. 6.Act.18. Venit Ephefum, inde Caefaream,Hierofolymam, Antiochiam ; poftad Galatas & Phryges.ibid. Paulus biennium manet Ephefi,& amplius.Act.19.ibi pugnat cum beftiis, 1.Cor.4.10

56.Ephefo proficifcitur in Macedoniam. Act.20. peragrat ecclesias Graeciae: fcribit utramque ad Corinthios,Philippis ; priorem ad Timotheum Laodicea,posteriorem ad Titum Nicopoli.Redit Corinthum,indeque fcribit epiftolam adRoma-15nos, poftquam euangelio omnia impleffet inde ab Hierofolymis usque ad Illyricum. Rom. 15.

57.Paulus Affo vehitur Mitylenam, Chium, Sa-mum,Miletum, Coum, Rhodum,Pataram,Ty-rum,Ptolemaida, Caefaream, ac tandem Hiero-20folymam. Ibi captus vinctusque fidei fuae ratione reddit.Act.21,22,23.Ducitur Caefaream.Act.23,24. 25,26. inde nau[?] vehitur Sidone cum Ariftarcho & Luca.Act.27.Sublegunt Cyprum, ftringunt o-ram Ciliciae & Pamphiliae. Veniunt Myra urbem25Lyciae ,ibiq; cofcendunt nauim Alexandrinam, qua vehuntur Gnidum verfus, indeque profecti veniunt in Cretam,Claudam, Melitam. Poft tres menfes veniunt Syracufas, Rhegium, Puteolos, ac per forum Appii & tres Tabernas tandem3058.Romam.Act.28.

59.Paulus Roma fcribit varias epiftolas; videl.ad Galatas,Ephefios,Philippenfes, Coloffenfes,po-fteriorem ad Timotheum ; item ad Philemonem & Hebraeos Romae manet biennium, & ann.6035exeunte liberatur exore leonis. 2.Tim.4.

page.notes: Right-margin numbers 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30, 35 are line numbers. "nau[?]" is doubtful: the abbreviation after "nau" is unclear. The brace joining notes 58 and 59 is read as two separate notes. Only the margin notes and text are printed; no other elements are shown.
